GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping and was hampered when carried out onto another runner. Rdr reported the gelding was not suited by the strong tempo and consequently failed to run out the distance. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Stwds to follow up on post-race condition .Co – trainer R. Archibald reported satisfaction with the post-race condition. He added that the gelding has been sent for a short freshen up and will continue with its current preparation.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out pressed on to face breeze 1.5L off, held together turn, Straightened Up half off, took over 200m, half clear 100m, headed late # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that it was not her intention to settle further forward, however, when caught wide and without cover through the early stages, and with the race being run at what she considered to be a moderate tempo, she allowed the gelding to stride forward and obtain an on-pace position near the 1400m.
